svg.title: J2 Record a credit or payment; edit and delete with Undo

g.text: J2 Record a credit or payment; edit and delete with Undo
[phone has a character other than digits, spaces and + ( ) - ., or is not 10 digits after phone10()]
[not a mobile: validMobile() wants 6, 7, 8 or 9 first]
v1.2: six buttons under the note field, in the chosen language:
groceries, milk, rice, oil, paid on UPI, cash
[the note already has a different word]
the note is saved with the entry as before
a new entry has no Undo; Undo is offered
after Edit, Delete and loading a shop
the app never sends by itself
[7 s pass, or a delete or import]
